source_issues.detail: Surprising word does not alone make a model bad; every recognizer/checker/MT system1980-2015, fifty years narrative, and modern adoption are sweeping historical/generalization claims. Preserved, not independently verified.
source_issues.action: Preserve fixed English meaning/payload; no source correction

source_issues.detail: Lossless rank sequence requires exactly reproducible guessing order and context. Shorter encoding relates rate to original symbols, not arbitrary output symbol alphabet; entropy bounds require coding/statistical assumptions. Three-quarters forced moves and measured before any model existed are source simplifications; no paper re-experiment claimed.
source_issues.action: Preserve fixed English meaning/payload; no source correction

source_issues.detail: bits↔nats base conversion is valid for same random variable/denominator. Per-letter vs per-word-token are not interchangeable merely changing log base. Cross-entropy coding interpretation uses base2; code uses natural log and includes EOS, so comparisons require aligned units/boundaries.
source_issues.action: Preserve fixed English meaning/payload; no source correction

source_issues.detail: Brown2007 30% statistic unsourced locally; no smoothing cannot evaluate any real text too absolute. Absolute discount applied to all counts description should be conditioned to seen counts; raw/higher-order/backoff/modified KN distinctions abridged. Francisco only one context is toy idealization rather than universal corpus property.
source_issues.action: Preserve fixed English meaning/payload; no source correction

source_issues.detail: Fixed known target support sums1 under valid discount. Doc injects1e-9 continuation for every arbitrary OOV, adding unnormalized mass beyond support; canonical returns0 for OOV given seen context but1e-9 if unknown context. Neither reserves/trains normalized UNK bucket.
source_issues.action: Preserve fixed English meaning/payload; no source correction

source_issues.detail: No discount range validation: D=2 gives probability sum2 on one-token corpus; D=-1 yields individual1.5 and sum2. Empty model returns epsilon for arbitrary queries. Finite fixtures establish limits without changing source.
source_issues.action: Preserve fixed English meaning/payload; no source correction

source_issues.detail: Caller must provide tokenized sentences, matching context length and fixed candidate vocabulary; n>=1/vocab_size>0 not validated. Querying extra OOV expands support without denominator adjustment. n=0 produces nonsensical counters instead of rejecting.
source_issues.action: Preserve fixed English meaning/payload; no source correction

source_issues.detail: Canonical Laplace denominator uses unigrams including EOS despite no outgoing EOS bigrams, thus EOS-context conditional support sum<1. Vocabulary includes start token while sampler excludes it, renormalizing over retained candidates. Typical generation stops at EOS but public function accepts it.
source_issues.action: Preserve fixed English meaning/payload; no source correction

source_issues.detail: Different seeds do not guarantee different outputs; deterministic support tested same sequence for1 and42. Greedy plus temperature is not beam search. generate implements probability sampling only, no argmax/temperature/beam.
source_issues.action: Preserve fixed English meaning/payload; no source correction

source_issues.detail: Zero total probability picks first candidate repeatedly because r<=acc at0; empty vocab returns unchanged prefix, empty prefix raises IndexError with nonempty vocab. Nonnegative/finite normalized probabilities not validated. Doc includes prefix/EOS in returned tokens; canonical strips them.
source_issues.action: Preserve fixed English meaning/payload; no source correction

source_issues.detail: Probability floor max(p,1e-12) makes impossible or negative-probability events finite1e12 PPL instead of infinity/error, concealing OOV/model invalidity. p>1 gives PPL<1; empty evaluation set divides by zero. Single empty sentence counts EOS; denominator includes EOS.
source_issues.action: Preserve fixed English meaning/payload; no source correction

source_issues.detail: Brown KN140 vsTransformer15-30 and Shakespeare30-50% improvement lack exact split/tokenizer/model/OOV/normalization setup; not reproduced.140/(15..30)=4.67..9.33, about10x loose high end. Neural-not-wide-margin means something wrong is not universal.
